trades.explain: Opened by 20/50 average cross down (short). Why it closed: stepped stop 1: the loss reached half the risk, so a part was sold to keep the loss small. Sold short at 2.9676, closed at 3.0305 (-2.12%).
Opened by 20/50 average cross down (short). Why it closed: too long at a loss: no progress after the maximum number of bars. Sold short at 2.9676, closed at 3.0270 (-2.00%).

Opened by 20/50 average cross down (short). Why it closed: take-profit 1: the price moved one R (the risk it took) its way, so a part was sold and the stop moved to the entry price. Sold short at 0.1480, closed at 0.1438 (+2.82%).

Opened by 20/50 average cross down (short). Why it closed: take-profit 2: the price moved two R its way, so another part was sold and the stop moved up to the first take-profit. Sold short at 0.1480, closed at 0.1395 (+5.75%).
